alex: quick check — about to merge a Terraform change that wires the payment-processor service config into ExternalSecrets. Before I merge, can someone confirm the mapping for `data.key` -> k8s secret keys and the rotation TTL we want for that token? PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/4522

maya: which secret exactly? the `payment_api_token` from Vault or the svc account key? paste of the ExternalSecret I think would help.

chris: this is the API token from Vault (path: kv/data/services/payment-processor). For ExternalSecrets we map `data.data.token` -> `payment_api_token` in the k8s Secret. Example suggestion:

```yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: payment-processor-secrets
spec:
  refreshInterval: "1m"
  secretStoreRef:
    name: vault-secret-store
    kind: SecretStore
  target:
    name: payment-processor
    template:
      type: Opaque
      data:
        PAYMENT_API_TOKEN: token
  data:
    - secretKey: token
      remoteRef:
        key: kv/data/services/payment-processor
        property: token
```

chris: TTL: I recommend rotation annotated on the ES object and a Vault policy TTL of 14d for this token. That balances risk and churn for downstream caches. annotation example: `secret.redwood.com/rotation: 14d`. Also wrap with KMS (customer-wide KMS) at rest — make sure `vault-secret-store` has `kmsWrap: true` in our overlay if you haven't already.

alex: putting the TF change here so you can eyeball, I'm updating the `k8s_external_secret` module call:

```hcl
module "payment_extsecret" {
  source = "git::ssh://git.redwood/infra/modules/k8s-external-secret.git"
  name   = "payment-processor-secrets"
  vault_path = "kv/data/services/payment-processor"
  property   = "token"
  annotations = {"secret.redwood.com/rotation" = "14d"}
}
```

maya: quick question — are we mounting as env var or as file? if env var, watch logs/ps leaks in some debuggers. prefer CSI driver mount for long-lived services. For stateless pods env is OK for now but add a note to the runbook.

sara: I can review the PR in a few. two tiny asks: (1) add `refreshInterval: "30s"` only for staging, keep prod at `1m`, (2) add `%EXPIRES_AT%` placeholder in the runbook so SRE can confirm rotation success.

alex: good catches — I'll add the staging override and runbook placeholder. also switched to CSI mount in the chart for the backend. pushing change in 10m. PR updated: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/4522 (now includes CSI opts + annotation).

infra-bot: CI / infra-pipeline #4522 — build passed ✅ (link: https://ci.redwood/4522)

chris: looks good to me, no blocking concerns. +1 on 14d and CSI.

sara: LGTM, approving now.

tim: I'll do a small canary rollout tonight to the staging cluster and watch logs for 2h, pinging oncall if anything odd. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks all — merging after CI green and will post a short after-action in #incidents if anything flakes.
